headline: Waters Corp. Reports Third-Quarter Revenue of $1.77 Billion
summary: Waters Corporation reported total third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.767 billion, exceeding its guidance midpoint by $14 million with organic growth of 9% as reported.
why: Waters Corp provides analytical instruments and software, serving as an indicator of demand in life sciences, materials science, and food testing markets.
